source: Black Death City Playtest v1.03 (printed page numbers; PDF page = printed + 1)

weapon_traits.text: Attack rolls made with this weapon score critical hits on a natural 5 or 6.

Uses the blast template: placed on any visible point within range (no closest-target rule), no attack roll for placement; on a miss (not a misfire) it scatters d6x2" and resolves as a hit. Never scores critical hits.

weapon_traits.reminder: Critical hits deal 1 damage when saved
weapon_traits.text: Each time an armour roll saves a critical hit from this weapon, the target suffers 1 damage.
If used by the defending fighter, it automatically has initiative if the attacker charged this activation.
Uses the flame template from the activating fighter's base; every visible fighter in it is automatically hit (never a critical), and cannot be in cover.
When parrying, a missed attack roll from this weapon can be discarded instead of a hit. Once each melee attack.
Cannot attack if the fighter has moved this activation; if used to attack, the fighter cannot move this activation.

If any ranged attack rolls are a natural 1, after resolving the other rolls make a misfire roll (d6): 1 Backfire (d3 damage, weapon unusable this battle); 2 Clogged (weapon unusable this battle); 3-6 Flash-in-the-Pan (miss).
Attacks made with this weapon cannot be used to parry.
Can be used as an off-hand weapon in melee (1 attack roll regardless of Attacks value).
Can only be used once each battle.

A fighter suffering damage from a critical hit with this weapon becomes poisoned: suffers 1 damage each time it activates; ends when healed or at 1 life remaining. Demons and Undead cannot be poisoned.
Rare 0-X: at most X fighters in the warband may carry this item/weapon.

weapon_traits.reminder: Forgo a Move or Action to reload
weapon_traits.text: Starts loaded; after each attack it must be reloaded by forgoing a Move or Action. Cannot reload while engaged.

weapon_traits.reminder: Unengaged fighters pass Willpower test or scatter d6"
weapon_traits.text: After the attack, each fighter hit that is not engaged takes a Willpower test; if failed it scatters d6".

A fighter can only carry 1 two-handed weapon and cannot make off-hand attacks while equipped with one. A held item with a two-handed melee weapon gives -1 Attacks; a held item cannot be carried with a two-handed ranged weapon.
Subtract 1 from attack rolls made with this weapon.
May split its Attacks among the first (legal) target and other visible, unengaged enemies within 3" of it, assigned before rolling.
Attacks made by this weapon cannot be parried and cannot be used to parry.

misfire_d6.1: Backfire: fighter suffers d3 damage; weapon cannot be used again this battle.
misfire_d6.2: Clogged: weapon cannot be used again this battle.

miscast_2d6.2: Inferno of Sorcery: spell fails; caster is taken down; blast template on caster, all other fighters in it suffer d6 damage.
miscast_2d6.3-5: Arcane Explosion: spell fails; blast template on caster, all fighters in it suffer d3 damage.
miscast_2d6.6-7: Drained Magic: spell fails; caster cannot use arcane actions for the rest of the battle.
miscast_2d6.8+: Uncontrolled Burst of Power: caster suffers d3 damage; if not taken down, the spell is critically cast.

reinforcements_d6.1-2: No Sight, No Sound: does not arrive; roll again next round.
reinforcements_d6.3-5: Arrival: set up within 3" horizontally of a battlefield edge connected to their entry point and more than 6" from all enemies.
reinforcements_d6.6: Outflank: set up anywhere wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge, more than 6" from all enemies.

skills.name: Dual-weapon Wielder
skills.text: Off-hand weapon attacks make 2 attack rolls instead of 1.

skills.name: Shooting Drills
skills.text: When reloading, take a Willpower test; if passed, no Move or Action needs to be forgone.

skills.name: Great Weapon Master
skills.text: Ignores the Unwieldy trait on melee weapons.

skills.name: Unshakeable
skills.text: Ignores the Fear special rule and all rules that would make it scatter.

skills.name: Tough Bastard
skills.text: Each activation while bloodied, take a Willpower test; if passed, heal 1 and no longer bloodied.

skills.name: Fast Learner
skills.text: Campaign: earns d6 bonus XP each aftermath.

skills.name: Duellist
skills.text: Can parry critical hits with any successful attack.

skills.name: Steady Aim
skills.text: +1 to ranged attack rolls while it has not moved this activation.
